title: Mapping the Movements of Love
long_title: Mapping the Movements of Love, A Map of Love, A Map of God, A Map of Being

versions.nirv: Anyone who does not love does not know God. God is love.
versions.leb: The one who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
versions.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν οὐ ἔγνω τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν.

versions.nirv: So we know the love that God has for us, and we rely on it. God is love. Anyone who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in them.
versions.leb: And we have known and have believed the love that God has in us. God is love, and the one who resides in love resides in God, and God resides in him.
versions.original: Καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐγνώκαμεν καὶ πεπιστεύκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχει ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν. ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν, καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει.
